sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves and dragon moves are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Ancient Power, Diamond Storm, Judgment, Luster Purge, Multi-Attack, Power Gem, Prismatic Laser, Rock Climb, Rock Smash, Rock Tomb, Strength, and Tera Starstorm: 1.5× stronger.
Aurora Beam, Dazzling Gleam, Doom Desire, Flash Cannon, Lumina Crash, Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom, Mirror Shot, Moongeist Beam, Photon Geyser, Signal Beam, and Techno Blast: 1.3× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Dragon-type.
Secret Power can cause burn, confusion, freezing, or sleep.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Bulldoze, Earthquake, Fissure, Magnitude, and Tectonic Rage change the field into Cave once their uses add up to 2 (Bulldoze 1, Earthquake 1, Fissure 1, Magnitude 1, and Tectonic Rage 2). The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.
Light That Burns the Sky changes the field into Dark Crystal Cavern.
Dark Pulse, Dark Void, and Night Daze change the field into Dark Crystal Cavern. The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Teraform Zero: Special Attack +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Special Attack +1 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
